en-US.prompt: From this immutable release {{MONICA_IMMUTABLE_REF}}, install the Monica Agent Skills into my current project directory: obtain the independent Monica Guide client from https://monica.dpdns.org/downloads, download the monica-framework skill bundle for this platform (`{rid}`) from the pinned Framework release, verify it against SHA256SUMS, and select that extracted bundle with --bundle <bundle-root> when running $monica-guide init --workspace <this repository> --profile <profile I confirm>, then $monica-guide configure --workspace <this repository> (preview first, then apply with the approved plan digest). The installation stays inside this repository. A machine-wide install that changes my user-level skill directory happens only if I explicitly ask for one. Verify with $monica-guide status --workspace <this repository>; restart the host only if discovery still fails. Then invoke $monica-guide, introduce its toolbox, global state, and the Monica framework source binding, and ask what I want to do next. After that installation, these restrictions apply until I choose an operation and approve its preview: Do not initialize another repository, select a different profile, install further Monica skills, bind or unbind source repositories, make any other file changes, or perform remote mutations.

zh-CN.prompt: 从这个不可变发布版本 {{MONICA_IMMUTABLE_REF}} 开始，把 Monica Agent Skills 安装进我当前的项目目录：从 https://monica.dpdns.org/downloads 获取独立 Monica Guide 客户端，再下载该 Framework 版本与当前平台匹配的 monica-framework 技能包（`{rid}`），对照 SHA256SUMS 校验后，用 --bundle <解压目录> 选择技能包，先运行 $monica-guide init --workspace <本仓库> --profile <我确认的 profile>，再运行 $monica-guide configure --workspace <本仓库>（先审阅打印的预览，再用批准的计划摘要应用）。除非我明确要求整机安装，这次安装只写入本仓库内部。用 $monica-guide status --workspace <本仓库> 验证；只有发现仍失败时才重启宿主。随后调用 $monica-guide，介绍其工具箱、全局状态以及 Monica 框架源码绑定，并询问我下一步想做什么。完成这次安装后，在我选择操作并批准其预览之前，以下限制适用：不要初始化其他仓库、选择其他 profile、安装后续 Monica Skill、绑定或解绑源码、不要再修改其他文件或执行远程变更。
